The '''Bantha Drifts Tunnel''' was a tunnel that linked the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] to the [[Banthan Drifts]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]],<ref name="TOR:BDT">{{TORcite|type=location|Bantha Drifts Tunnel|Tatooine}}</ref> on the other side of the rock formations that bordered the Chasm.<ref name="TOR:NC" />
